culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total investments-non-controlled/affiliated | fair value 32,227 | 1.79% of net assets

findings.detail: The 32.227m affiliated-investments subtotal was included in addition to the filing grand total, overstating extracted fair value by exactly 32.227m.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation: the schedule grand total at table 29 row 8 is 2,604.079m, consistent with the balance-sheet total investments at fair value, while the extracted position sum is 2,636.306m. The 32.227m residual exactly equals the affiliated-investments subtotal at table 29 row 7, which is immediately followed by the inclusive grand total. This proves a subtotal leak/double count rather than a bad filing anchor.
